name: Orchestration & Tooling
oneLiner: The glue around a model call: prompts, retrieval, tools, frameworks, evaluation and guardrails.

analogy.text: A film crew around an actor: scripts, props and cues so the performance fits the scene.
analogy.breaks: An actor improvises from real understanding of the set. A model only sees what is placed in its context window: if the crew forgets a prop, for the model it doesn't exist.

givesAbove: Reliable, grounded model calls that can use your data and tools.
